fields.Name: T320 - Scheduling Activity Time Range Chips
fields.Description: Tests the OnTimeRangeChange chip control that re-drives the service date range and reloads executions/trends — a scheduling-specific time-window selector with no analogue in the generic grid tests.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Scheduling' application, then open its 'Activity' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. In the toolbar there are time-range chips: '24 Hours', '7 Days', '30 Days', '90 Days' (7 Days is active by default). Click a different range chip (e.g. '30 Days') and verify the chip becomes the active/selected one and the activity view reloads for that window (the executions list and/or trends chart refresh). Seeing the selected chip change and the view respond is success — the exact number of rows is irrelevant and an empty state is acceptable.

judgeValidationCriteria: Time-range chips (24 Hours / 7 Days / 30 Days / 90 Days) are visible with one marked active
Clicking a different range makes it the active chip and the activity content refreshes for that window (rows/trends update or a valid empty-state shows)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
